text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Special Week versus Grass Wonder!
Wow, I have
no idea who's gonna win!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
But what about Seiun Sky? Well, I guess
she
couldn't train much while trying to
recover...

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I don't really think she has a
chance. Who
knows what effect that
injury had on her? It's a
total shame.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Can you believe that? Apparently a lot
of people
are doubting my chances!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Well, not like I can blame 'em. Those two were able to train like normal. I'm chopped liver compared to them.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Yikes" is right! Guess I'll never be
anyone's
favorite to win. Boo-hoo.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
But that's exactly what's going to make
this race
fun enough to scream in
delight. ♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Wahaha! ♪ Of course they are! All that's
left is to
watch 'em unfold!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I'm as carefree as the wind. Welp, time
to race.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
You're about to be wowed beyond
belief,
Trainer. ♪

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text: But... you know, it is Seiun Sky we're talking about.

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text:
If anyone can pull off something
incredible, it's
her.
